title: Privacy Policy
summary: This Privacy Policy describes how Antellay-X collects, uses, protects, and discloses personal information obtained through our websites, autonomous robotics platforms, cloud systems, and related enterprise services.

blocks.text: Antellay-X ('we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your personal data and upholding high standards of privacy and security. This Privacy Policy applies to all users of https://x.antellay.in, our client portals, physical AI developer interfaces, and enterprise robotics management systems.
By accessing or using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the practices described in this document.
We collect information to provide, maintain, and optimize our physical AI systems and client partnerships. The categories of data we collect include:

items: Direct Contact Details: Name, corporate email address, organization name, telephone number, and job title provided via inquiry and meeting forms.
Enterprise Project Requirements: Technical specifications, operational environment parameters, robotics fleet deployment needs, and facility requirements.
Telemetry & Operational Data: Non-personal system metrics, edge sensor diagnostics, latency analytics, and hardware performance data from connected robot platforms.
Technical Web Data: IP address, browser type, device identifiers, session timestamps, and navigation behavior collected via essential performance cookies.

blocks.text: Antellay-X processes collected data strictly for legitimate business purposes, contract fulfillment, and product optimization. Specifically, we use your data to:

items: Respond to corporate inquiries, schedule technological demonstrations, and fulfill enterprise partnership requests.
Deliver, configure, and maintain autonomous physical AI systems and fleet management portals.
Continuously improve neural perception models, edge actuation precision, and system safety protocols.
Maintain legal compliance, prevent malicious intrusion, and enforce platform security safeguards.

blocks.text: We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. Data is only disclosed under strict confidentiality in the following circumstances:

items: Authorized Service Providers: Trusted cloud hosting, infrastructure monitoring, and communications partners bound by rigorous data protection agreements.
Corporate Affiliates: Entities within the Celebso Group under unified enterprise privacy and security governance.
Legal & Regulatory Requirements: When required by law, subpoena, or valid regulatory enforcement actions to protect system integrity and public safety.

blocks.text: We implement state-of-the-art administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to prevent unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or alteration of personal data. All data transmissions are encrypted using TLS 1.3, and resting data is safeguarded with AES-256 encryption.
Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, satisfy contractual obligations, or comply with statutory retention requirements.
Depending on your jurisdiction (including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and applicable data privacy regulations), you have rights regarding your personal data:

items: Right to Access: Request a copy of the personal information we maintain about you.
Right to Correction: Request prompt correction of inaccurate or incomplete records.
Right to Deletion: Request the erasure of your personal data when no longer needed for lawful purposes.
Right to Restrict or Object: Restrict processing or opt out of non-essential communications at any time.
